pipeline.title: Discover
pipeline.copy: We write down who will use it, and what done looks like, before anything is built.

pipeline.title: Design
pipeline.copy: Screens and the tools an agent may call are agreed before production code.

lines.text: listing tools the agent may call

pipeline.title: Build
pipeline.copy: Small pieces you can try, with the important path tested, and progress each week.

lines.text: shipping a piece you can try
tests on the path that matters

pipeline.title: Hand over
pipeline.copy: The build is deployed, walked through, and left with you. Launch is the handover, not a surprise.
